question: Should OpenClaw accept startedAt as the same-session run-generation boundary for WebChat Stop lifecycle terminalization after this PR is ported to current main?
rationale: The fix is narrow and well-proven for the direct Stop bug, but it changes persisted session lifecycle terminalization, so maintainers should explicitly own the session-state invariant before merge.

options.title: Port Direct-Stop Fix
options.body: Port the client abort reconciliation to ui/src/pages/chat, keep the canonical Gateway startedAt guard, and review the resulting branch for the direct WebChat Stop bug only.

options.title: Broaden To Compaction
options.body: Require this branch to add reproduction and coverage for the compaction/restartRecoveryRuns context-loss variant before merge.

options.title: Pause For Unified Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want a single stronger run-generation owner across Stop, restart recovery, channel runs, and compaction races.

recommendation.title: Port Direct-Stop Fix
recommendation.body: Port the client abort reconciliation to ui/src/pages/chat, keep the canonical Gateway startedAt guard, and review the resulting branch for the direct WebChat Stop bug only.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned and already reviewed the stale-run race that now anchors the remaining maintainer decision.
